card.text:
When the generator shown rotates, there is an a.c. electromotive force (e.m.f.) across the resistor between points P and Q.
Diagram 1 shows the position of the coil at time \(\mathit{t}\ \mathrm{=}\ \mathrm{0}\).
The coil rotates clockwise. At time \({\mathit{t}}_{\mathrm{1}}\), the coil position is horizontal, as shown in diagram 2.
{{f1}}
The graph shows the output e.m.f. between points P and Q plotted against time.
Which point shows the e.m.f. at time \({\mathit{t}}_{\mathrm{1}}\)?
{{f2}}
